entities.summary: Mauro Mendes Ferreira is a Brazilian politician. He is the former mayor of Cuiabá and is the governor of Mato Grosso, having been elected in the 2018 election and reelected in the 2022 election. He is a member of Brazil Union. Mauro Mendes was a performers & entertainers from Anápolis (b. 1964-04-12, Anápolis). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
